line-height: 230%;"><div style="line-height: 230%;"><div style="line-height: 230%;"><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">def binary_search(arr, target, low, high):</span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;if low &gt; high:</span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;return -1</span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;"><br></span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; mid = (low + high) // 2</span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><br></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;if arr[mid] == target:</span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;return mid</span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;elif arr[mid] &lt; target:</span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;return binary_search(arr, target, mid + 1, high)</span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;else:</span></div><div style="line-height: 230%;"><span style="font-size: 20px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;return binary_search(arr, target, low, mid - 1)</span></div></div></div></div>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="-175" y="50" width="480" height="380" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Gb0BwUZtEb_tHkObCk-i-11" value="<font color="#ff0000" style="font-size: 18px;">T(n) = O(1), performing the&nbsp;</font><div><font color="#ff0000" style="font-size: 18px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; constant time operation&nbsp;</font></div><div><font color="#ff0000" style="font-size: 18px;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; at each level.</font></div>" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="190" y="175" width="320" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Gb0BwUZtEb_tHkObCk-i-13" value="" style="shape=curlyBracket;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;rounded=1;flipH=1;labelPosition=right;verticalLabelPosition=middle;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;strokeWidth=2;size=0.5;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="130" y="110" width="20" height="210" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Gb0BwUZtEb_tHkObCk-i-14" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;rounded=0;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="350" y="440" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="290" y="410" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Gb0BwUZtEb_tHkObCk-i-15" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;rounded=0;" edge="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry width="50" height="50" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="350" y="440" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="280" y="360" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="Gb0BwUZtEb_tHkObCk-i-16" value="<font color="#cc00cc" style="font-size: 18px;">Recursive Calls</font>" style="text;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;resizable=0;points=[];autosize=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="295" y="430" width="150" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
